review_method: Classified from the two unlabeled randomized A/B sheets at their native 384-pixel width. Direction labels and key were not inspected.

pairs.reason: A nose/chin projects left with green irises toward image-left; B face is closer frontal but nose and irises lean image-right.
A shows leftward head yaw and leftward pupils; B near eye is fuller on the image-left side while nose/mouth project right.
A nose tip lies right of skull center and right far eye is narrowed; B nose tip projects left and the image-right near eye is more exposed.
Both are stronger sideways turns: A face/nose projects right, B face/nose projects left, with coherent opposite eye foreshortening.
A lowered face has leftward nose projection and lower-left irises; B lowered face has rightward projection with larger image-left near eye.
A chin/nose and visible irises angle slightly left under bangs; B chin/nose angles right, with the image-right eye compressed. Both horizontal cues are subtle because of strong downward pitch.

A very low face retains slight leftward nose projection and a fuller image-right eye; B retains slight rightward projection and fuller image-left eye. Subtle cues near downward pose, but no opposite turn observed.
A raised chin and exposed upper-looking irises aim above; B chin is tucked under bangs, eyes and lower face aim down.
A chin lifts and pupils rise toward upper lids; B forehead/bangs overlap more of the eyes and the chin/irises point down.
A tucked chin and low irises produce a downward face; B has lifted chin and eyes raised toward the upper edge.
A raised chin and upper pupils accompany its sideways yaw; B lowers chin and looks below with lowered eyelids.
A bangs overlap low-looking eyes and the nose/chin tuck toward apron; B exposes an upward tilted face with upper irises.
A face angles down-left and chin tucks; B chin rises and green eyes look above while yawing sideways.
A gaze is below eye level with lowered chin; B gaze rises toward upper lids with clearly raised chin.
